newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC Markets announces new appointments.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Markets announces new appointments.

text.p: HSBC Markets said on Friday it has appointed Mark Bucknall head of capital markets as part of a series of changes to its capital markets line-up.
The capital markets arm of Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corp said in a statement Bucknall's appointment brought together its new issues and sales teams.

Another change brought together responsibility for all Asian currency derivatives and fixed income products and Asian credit products in Group of Seven currencies under a new head of fixed income and derivative trading in Hong Kong, Ken Yeadon.
The statement said Bucknall would report to the bank's treasurer Stuart Gulliver, and Yeadon would report to deputy treasurer Mike Powell, who is also head of interest rate trading.
It said David Behan would return to HSBC Markets in London to take up the new position of emerging markets sales director.
Behan would be responsible for emerging markets sales teams in London, New York and Tokyo, including debt and derivatives products, HSBC Markets said.
